title: Super El Niño Declared as Forecasters Warn of Major Winter Weather Shifts
detail: News coverage reports a Super El Niño has been declared, with forecasters warning of major shifts in winter weather.

title: NOAA CPC November ENSO Discussion: Strong-to-Very-Strong El Niño Likely Through Jan–Mar 2027
detail: CPC's Nov 12 ENSO Diagnostic Discussion keeps the El Niño Advisory in place with Niño-3.4 at +2.5°C (relative index) and a greater than 79% chance of a strong-to-very strong event through January–March 2027. It puts the chance of a historic event (3-month RONI of +2.5°C or more) at about 60% for Oct–Dec and Nov–Jan. CPC reports RONI, so values read lower than IRI weekly anomalies.
